classification.difficultyReason: Direct recognition or a familiar short procedure. Page 49 supplies the disjointness criterion and page 42 illustrates even integers; recognising 2 as prime remains a prerequisite.

content.prompt:
For each of the following, determine if the sets are disjoint or not disjoint.
$$\begin{aligned}A&=\{\text{even \#’s}\}\\B&=\{\text{prime \#’s}\}\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked: $2$ is both even and prime, so $2\in A\cap B$. Thus the intersection is nonempty and the sets are not disjoint.
